title: Sarama consoles Seetha
introduction: Seetha asks Sarama to go secretly to Ravana and get to know what he is doing as well as report to her back about Ravana's decision about the matter of releasing her or continuing to keep her captive. Sarama secretly hears the conversation of Ravana with his ministers and reports to Seetha that Ravana is not inclined to set her free. Sarama consoles Seetha, saying that Rama with his sharp arrows will kill Ravana and take her back to Ayodhya.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 34th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
अथ ताम् जात सम्तापाम् तेन वाक्येन मोदिताम् |
सरमा ह्लादयाम् आस महीं दग्धामिवाम्भसा
verses.iast:
atha tām jāta samtāpām tena vākyena moditām |
saramā hlādayām āsa mahīṃ dagdhāmivāmbhasā
verses.translation: Seetha, who was overwhelmed with anguish on hearing Ravana's words, was comforted and rendered happy by Sarama, as parched earth is solaced by rain.

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तस्या हितम् सख्याश् चिकीर्षन्ती सखी वचः |
उवाच काले कालज्ना स्मित पूर्व अभिभाषिणी
verses.iast:
tatas tasyā hitam sakhyāś cikīrṣantī sakhī vacaḥ |
uvāca kāle kālajnā smita pūrva abhibhāṣiṇī
verses.translation: Desiring to be of further service to her friend Seetha, the affectionate Sarama, skilled in the knowledge of time, smiling while talking, spoke the following words at that appropriate time.

glosses.meaning: skilled in the knowledge of time

verses.devanagari:
उत्सहेयम् अहम् गत्वा त्वद् वाक्यम् असित ईक्षणे |
निवेद्य कुशलम् रामे प्रतिच्चन्ना निवर्तितुम्
verses.iast:
utsaheyam aham gatvā tvad vākyam asita īkṣaṇe |
nivedya kuśalam rāme praticcannā nivartitum
verses.translation: "O, black eyed lady! I am capable of carrying a message of your words and good will to Rama and to return secretly."

verses.devanagari:
न हि मे क्रममाणाया निरालम्बे विहायसि |
समर्थो गतिम् अन्वेतुम् पवनो गरुडो अपि वा
verses.iast:
na hi me kramamāṇāyā nirālambe vihāyasi |
samartho gatim anvetum pavano garuḍo api vā
verses.translation: "When I am journeying in the sky self -supported, neither the god of wind nor Garuda the eagle can follow my movement."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवाणाम् ताम् सीता सरमाम् पुनर् अब्रवीत् |
मधुरम् श्लक्ष्णया वाचा पूर्व शोक अभिपन्नया
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇām tām sītā saramām punar abravīt |
madhuram ślakṣṇayā vācā pūrva śoka abhipannayā
verses.translation: To Sarama, who was speaking as aforesaid, Seetha her voice no longer charged with grief, gently and sweetly replied in the following words:

verses.devanagari:
समर्था गगनम् गन्तुम् अपि वा त्वम् रसा तलम् |
अवगच्चाम्य् अकर्तव्यम् कर्तव्यम् ते मद् अन्तरे
verses.iast:
samarthā gaganam gantum api vā tvam rasā talam |
avagaccāmy akartavyam kartavyam te mad antare
verses.translation: "You are capable of going to heaven or to the penultimate subterranean region. Know from me today the duty that has got to be performed by you for my sake."

glosses.meaning: that has got to be performed

verses.devanagari:
मत् प्रियम् यदि कर्तव्यम् यदि बुद्धिः स्थिरा तव |
ज्नातुम् इच्चामि तम् गत्वा किम् करोति इति रावणः
verses.iast:
mat priyam yadi kartavyam yadi buddhiḥ sthirā tava |
jnātum iccāmi tam gatvā kim karoti iti rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "If your intention is to act kindly towards me and your resolve is firm , I wish you to go and know what Ravana is doing now."

verses.devanagari:
स हि माया बलः क्रूरो रावणः शत्रु रावणः |
माम् मोहयति दुष्ट आत्मा पीत मात्रा इव वारुणी
verses.iast:
sa hi māyā balaḥ krūro rāvaṇaḥ śatru rāvaṇaḥ |
mām mohayati duṣṭa ātmā pīta mātrā iva vāruṇī
verses.translation: "That cruel and evil minded Ravana, equipped with strength in the shape of conjuring tricks, who makes his enemies cry has bemused me, as spirituous liquor bemuses one, the moment it is imbibed."

glosses.meaning: equipped with strength in the shape of conjuring tricks

verses.devanagari:
तर्जापयति माम् नित्यम् भर्त्सापयति च असक्र्त् |
राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर् या माम् रक्षन्ति नित्यशः
verses.iast:
tarjāpayati mām nityam bhartsāpayati ca asakrt |
rākṣasībhiḥ sughorābhir yā mām rakṣanti nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: "He causes me to be threatened by words all the time by the most frightful ogresses, who always surround me and insult me by their act repeatedly."

glosses.meaning: he causes me to be threatened by words

verses.devanagari:
उद्विग्ना शन्किता च अस्मि न च स्वस्थम् मनो मम |
तद् भयाच् च अहम् उद्विग्ना;अशोक वनिकाम् गताः
verses.iast:
udvignā śankitā ca asmi na ca svastham mano mama |
tad bhayāc ca aham udvignā;aśoka vanikām gatāḥ
verses.translation: "I am depressed in mind and distrustful. My mind is not in its natural state. Staying in Ashoka grove, I am distressed because of his fear."

glosses.meaning: is not in its natural state

verses.devanagari:
यदि नाम कथा तस्य निश्चितम् वा अपि यद् भवेत् |
निवेदयेथाः सर्वम् तत् परो मे स्याद् अनुग्रहः
verses.iast:
yadi nāma kathā tasya niścitam vā api yad bhavet |
nivedayethāḥ sarvam tat paro me syād anugrahaḥ
verses.translation: "Report to me, all that is decided by him during his talk going on with his ministers about the matter of releasing me or keeping me captive. It will be of great service to me."

verses.devanagari:
साप्येवम् ब्रुवतीम् सीताम् सरमा वल्गु भाषिणी |
उवाच वचनम् तस्याः स्पृशन्ती बाष्प विक्लवम्
verses.iast:
sāpyevam bruvatīm sītām saramā valgu bhāṣiṇī |
uvāca vacanam tasyāḥ spṛśantī bāṣpa viklavam
verses.translation: The soft spoken Sarama, wiping her face, which got moist with tears, replied as follows to Seetha who was speaking as aforesaid:

verses.devanagari:
एष ते यद्य् अभिप्रायस् तस्माद् गच्चामि जानकि |
गृह्य शत्रोर् अभिप्रायम् उपाव्र्त्ताम् च पश्य माम्
verses.iast:
eṣa te yady abhiprāyas tasmād gaccāmi jānaki |
gṛhya śatror abhiprāyam upāvrttām ca paśya mām
verses.translation: "If your opinion is like this, I shall go on that account, O, Seetha! Having grasped the feeling of the enemies, I shall return O, Seetha!"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा ततो गत्वा समीपम् तस्य रक्षसः |
शुश्राव कथितम् तस्य रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः
verses.iast:
evam uktvā tato gatvā samīpam tasya rakṣasaḥ |
śuśrāva kathitam tasya rāvaṇasya samantriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Speaking thus, Surama thereafter went to the vicinity of that demon and heard the conversation of Ravana who was with his ministers.

verses.devanagari:
सा श्रुत्वा निश्चयम् तस्य निश्चयज्ना दुरात्मनः |
पुनर् एव अगमत् क्षिप्रम् अशोक वनिकाम् तदा
verses.iast:
sā śrutvā niścayam tasya niścayajnā durātmanaḥ |
punar eva agamat kṣipram aśoka vanikām tadā
verses.translation: Sarama, who knew how to investigate could hear the wicked Ravana's resolve and soon returned to Ashoka grove.

verses.devanagari:
सा प्रविष्टा पुनस् तत्र ददर्श जनक आत्मजाम् |
प्रतीक्षमाणाम् स्वाम् एव भ्रष्ट पद्माम् इव श्रियम्
verses.iast:
sā praviṣṭā punas tatra dadarśa janaka ātmajām |
pratīkṣamāṇām svām eva bhraṣṭa padmām iva śriyam
verses.translation: Sarama, who entered the Ashoka grove, saw Seetha who looked like Lakshmi the goddess of prosperity (and the wife of Vishnu); bereft of the lotus and waiting for her only.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तु सीता पुनः प्राप्ताम् सरमाम् वल्गु भाषिणीम् |
परिष्वज्य च सुस्निग्धम् ददौ च स्वयम् आसनम्
verses.iast:
tām tu sītā punaḥ prāptām saramām valgu bhāṣiṇīm |
pariṣvajya ca susnigdham dadau ca svayam āsanam
verses.translation: Seetha affectionately embraced the kindly speaking Surama who returned there and offered personally a seat to her.

verses.devanagari:
इह आसीना सुखम् सर्वम् आख्याहि मम तत्त्वतः |
क्रूरस्य निश्चयम् तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
iha āsīnā sukham sarvam ākhyāhi mama tattvataḥ |
krūrasya niścayam tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Sitting here comfortably, tell me about the real design of that cruel and wicked Ravana"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु सरमा सीतया वेपमानया |
कथितम् सर्वम् आचष्त रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu saramā sītayā vepamānayā |
kathitam sarvam ācaṣta rāvaṇasya samantriṇaḥ
verses.translation: When Seetha trembling with fear enquired thus, Sarama narrated all the conversation of Ravana together with his ministers.

verses.devanagari:
जनन्या राक्षस इन्द्रो वै त्वन् मोक्ष अर्थम् बृहद् वचः |
अविद्धेन च वैदेहि मन्त्रि वृद्धेन बोधितः
verses.iast:
jananyā rākṣasa indro vai tvan mokṣa artham bṛhad vacaḥ |
aviddhena ca vaidehi mantri vṛddhena bodhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Excellent words were spoken by Kaikasi, the mother of Ravana as well as Aviddha the aged minister asking for your release, O Seetha!"

glosses.meaning: with the aim of your release.

verses.devanagari:
दीयताम् अभिसत्क्र्त्य मनुज इन्द्राय मैथिली |
निदर्शनम् ते पर्याप्तम् जन स्थाने यद् अद्भुतम्
verses.iast:
dīyatām abhisatkrtya manuja indrāya maithilī |
nidarśanam te paryāptam jana sthāne yad adbhutam
verses.translation: "Let Seetha, be restored honorably to Rama the Lord of men. That wonderful** thing happened in Janasthana is an enough eye- opener to you."
notes: ** Rama exterminated fourteen thousand demons led by such great warriors as Khara and Dushana at Janastana.

glosses.meaning: to Rama the lord of men

verses.devanagari:
लन्घनम् च समुद्रस्य दर्शनम् च हनूमतः |
वधम् च रक्षसाम् युद्धे कः कुर्यान् मानुषो भुवि
verses.iast:
langhanam ca samudrasya darśanam ca hanūmataḥ |
vadham ca rakṣasām yuddhe kaḥ kuryān mānuṣo bhuvi
verses.translation: "Which mortal would accomplish the crossing of the ocean, the discovery of Seetha by Hanuman, and the carnage of the demons in combat on this earth?"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् स मन्त्रि वृद्धैश्च मात्रा च बहु भाषितः |
न त्वाम् उत्सहते मोक्तुम् अर्तह्म् अर्थ परो यथा
verses.iast:
evam sa mantri vṛddhaiśca mātrā ca bahu bhāṣitaḥ |
na tvām utsahate moktum artahm artha paro yathā
verses.translation: "Though admonished in many ways by the aged ministers and his mother he is not inclined to set you free, any more than a miser would leave his hold on his riches.

verses.devanagari:
न उत्सहत्य् अम्र्तो मोक्तुम् युद्धे त्वाम् इति मैथिलि |
सामात्यस्य नृशंसस्य निश्चयो ह्य् एष वर्तते
verses.iast:
na utsahaty amrto moktum yuddhe tvām iti maithili |
sāmātyasya nṛśaṃsasya niścayo hy eṣa vartate
verses.translation: "O, Seetha! He does not want to release you, without dying himself in a battle. This is the resolve of the cruel Ravana along with his ministers."

verses.devanagari:
तद् एषा सुस्थिरा बुद्धिर्मृत्यु लोभाद् उपस्थिता |
भयान् न शक्तस् त्वाम् मोक्तुम् अनिरस्तस् तु सम्युगे
राक्षसानाम् च सर्वेषाम् आत्मनश् च वधेन हि |
verses.iast:
tad eṣā susthirā buddhirmṛtyu lobhād upasthitā |
bhayān na śaktas tvām moktum anirastas tu samyuge
rākṣasānām ca sarveṣām ātmanaś ca vadhena hi |
verses.translation: -"Thereafter, due to infatuation caused by his impending death, his aforesaid determination is very firm .He is not in a position to release you, not through sheer fear, but until he is actually defeated in battle through the carnage of all the demons and of himself."

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य रावणम् सम्ख्ये सर्वथा निशितैः शरैः
प्रतिनेष्यति रामस् त्वाम् अयोध्याम् असित ईक्षणे |
verses.iast:
nihatya rāvaṇam samkhye sarvathā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
pratineṣyati rāmas tvām ayodhyām asita īkṣaṇe |
verses.translation: "O, dark eyed Seetha! Killing Ravana by his sharp arrows in combat, Rama will take you back to Ayodhya by all means."

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे शब्दो भेरी शन्ख समाकुलः
श्रुतो वै सर्व सैन्यानाम् कम्पयन् धरणी तलम् |
verses.iast:
etasminn antare śabdo bherī śankha samākulaḥ
śruto vai sarva sainyānām kampayan dharaṇī talam |
verses.translation: In the meantime was heard the sound of all the monkey troops blended with the sound of kettle drums, causing earth to shake.

glosses.itrans: causing earth to shake. w.wM-etasmin antare
glosses.iast: causing earth to śake. v.vṃ-etasmin antare
glosses.devanagari: चौसिन्ग् एअर्थ् तो शके. व्.व्ं एतस्मिन् अन्तरे

glosses.meaning: blended with the sound of kettle drums

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा तु तम् वानर सैन्य शब्दम् |
लन्का गता राक्षस राज भ्र्त्याः |
नष्ट ओजसो दैन्य परीत चेष्टाः |
श्रेयो न पश्यन्ति न्र्पस्य दोषैः
verses.iast:
śrutvā tu tam vānara sainya śabdam |
lankā gatā rākṣasa rāja bhrtyāḥ |
naṣṭa ojaso dainya parīta ceṣṭāḥ |
śreyo na paśyanti nrpasya doṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Hearing that sound of that monkey troops, the servants of Ravana stationed in Lanka were lack- luster with their movements, overcome by depression. They did not see anything salutary in it, owing to the fault of their king.

glosses.itrans: owing to the fault of their king. wM-shrutvaa
glosses.iast: oving to the fault of their king. vṃ-śrutvā
glosses.devanagari: ओविन्ग् तो थे fऔल्त् ओf थेइर् किन्ग्. व्ं श्रुत्वा

glosses.meaning: with their movements overcome by depression
